thag17.3:1.1: Pisunena ca kodhanena maccharinā ca vibhūtinandinā sakhitaṃ na kareyya paṇḍito; pāpo kāpurisena saṃgamo. || ||
thag17.3:2.1: saddhena ca pesalena ca paññavatā bahussutena ca sakhitaṃ hi kareyya paṇḍito; bhaddo sappurisena saṃgamo.
thag17.3:8.1: bahussuto cittakathī buddhassa paricārako pannabhāro visaññutto seyyaṃ kappeti Gotamo. || ||
thag17.3:9.1: khīṇāsavo visaññutto saṅgātīto sunibbuto dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ jātimaraṇapāragu. || ||
thag17.3:10.1: yasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā dhammā buddhassādiccabandhuno nibbānagamane magge, so 'yaṃ tiṭṭhati Gotamo. || ||
thag17.3:11.1: dvāsītiṃ buddhato gaṇhi, dve sahassāni bhikkhuto: caturāsīti sahassāni ye 'me dhammā pavattino. || ||
thag17.3:12.1: appassuto 'yaṃ puriso balivaddo va jīrati, maṃsāni tassa vaḍḍhanti, paññā tassa na vaḍḍhati. || ||
thag17.3:13.1: bahussuto appasutaṃ yo sutenātimaññati, andho padīpadhāro va tath' eva paṭibhāti maṃ. || ||
thag17.3:14.1: bahussutaṃ upāseyya sutañ ca na vināsaye; taṃ mūlaṃ brahmacariyassa; tasmā dhammadharo siyā. || ||
thag17.3:15.1: pubbāparaññū atthaññū niruttipadakovido suggahītañ ca gaṇhāti atthañ copaparikkhati. || ||
thag17.3:16.1: khantyā chandikato hoti, ussahitvā tuleti taṃ, samaye so padahati ajjhattaṃ susamāhito. || ||
thag17.3:17.1: bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ sappaññaṃ buddhasāvakaṃ dhammaviññāṇaṃ ākaṅkhaṃ taṃ bhajetha tathāvidhaṃ. || ||
thag17.3:18.1: bahussuto dhammadharo kosārakkho mahesino cakkhu sabbassa lokassa pūjaneyyo bahussuto || ||
thag17.3:19.1: dhammārāmo dhammarato dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ dhammaṃ anussaraṃ bhikkhu saddhammā na parihāyati. || ||
thag17.3:20.1: kāyamaccheragaruno hiyyamāne anuṭṭhahe sarīrasukhagiddhassa kuto samaṇaphāsutā. || ||
thag17.3:21.1: na pakkhanti disā sabbā, dhammā na paṭibhanti maṃ, gate kalyāṇamittamhi andhakāraṃ va khāyati. || ||
thag17.3:22.1: abbhatītasahāyassa atītagatasatthuno n' atthi etādisaṃ mittaṃ yathā kāyagatā sati. || ||
thag17.3:23.1: ye purāṇā atītā te, navehi na sameti me, sv ajja eko 'va jhāyāmi vassupeto va pakkhimā. || ||
thag17.3:24.1: dassanāya atikkante nānāverajjake bahū mā vārayittha sotāro, passantu samayo mamaṃ. || ||
thag17.3:25.1: dassanāya atikkante nānāverajjake puthū karoti satthā okāsaṃ na nivāreti cakkhumā. || ||
thag17.3:26.1: paṇṇavīsativassāni sekhabhūtassa me sato na kāmasaññā uppajji, passa dhammasudhammataṃ. || ||
thag17.3:27.1: paṇṇavīsativassāni sekhabhūtassa me sato na dosasaññā uppajji, passa dhammasudhammataṃ. || ||
thag17.3:28.1: paṇṇavīsativassāni bhagavantaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ mettena kāyakammena -- mettena vacikammena
thag17.3:31.1: buddhassa caṅkamantassa piṭṭhito anucaṅkamiṃ, dhamme desiyamānamhi ñāṇaṃ me udapajjatha. || ||
thag17.3:32.1: ahaṃ sakaraṇīyo 'mhi sekho appattamānaso, satthu ca parinibbānaṃ yo amhaṃ anukampako. || ||
thag17.3:33.1: tadāsi yaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ, tadāsi lomahaṃsanaṃ sabbākāravarūpete sambuddhe parinibbute. || ||
thag17.3:34.1: bahussuto dhammadharo kosārakkho mahesino cakkhu sabbassa lokassa Ānando parinibbuto. || ||
thag17.3:36.1: gatimanto satīmanto dhitimanto ca yo isi saddhammādhārako thero Ānando ratanākaro. || ||
thag17.3:38.0: thero. uddānaṃ: Phusso Upatisso Ānando tayo 'ti 'me pakittitā; gāthāyo tattha saṃkhātā sataṃ pañca ca uttarīti.
